limits: This is a review of sealed original captures only. No new SDK, app, observer, preview, screenshot or native check execution occurred. Source, bridge, actions, design and plans were not changed.
Exact color ARGB/policy sampling assertions remain unassessed; no offline sampling was substituted for absent original native pixel results.
iOS title-native-weight remains unassessed in all seven states per case.

Disabled choice observations are blocked_disabled, not successful callback stimuli. Their absence of callback is not promoted into an extra callback pass. Disabled native enablement is independently observed and typed checked.

Android dispatch is Compose semantic OnClick in an attached continuous session, not OS physical touch. iOS successful activation uses XCUI taps. No parent app navigation/lifecycle or physical hit-region claims.

Full-page visual wrapping/overlap review covers all98 original full-sweep viewport images across12 exact states. Native facts and allseven planned business checkpoints per case/platform were read. Other target states were not separately certified for full-page manual visual quality.
The P2 Android wrapping question remains U in baseline/expanded/submitted due to qualitative hyphen-break concerns; no visible characters were lost and no ellipsis or overlap was found.

Opening without selection, closing disclosure, moving an already-open dossier to another item, idempotent reselect, RTL, arbitrary new model data, all availability combinations and same-revision recomposition persistence are not exercised by the original public action route. Source declarations do not establish these runtime outcomes.
Reference vector font metrics are not a native pixel baseline; enlarged iOS and Android fonts have different valid native metrics. No font-size inference was made from reference screenshots.
